summary: Govern Research Library native qualification before staging or engine use.
details: The consumed browser harness admits resource budgets before allocation and uses the existing monitored materializer, private output tree and strict candidate lease. F210 uses current Steam 2.1; F200 uses the authorized historical 2.0 installation.

Candidate checks require source 4.2.1 numeric identity, exact filename and ZIP root, contained canonical paths and five byte-matching browser modules. Every engine phase retains resource ledgers; child-only Steam identifiers and UTF-8 preserve launch isolation and argument diagnostics.

Consumed controls exercise actual admission functions, synthetic identity/module archives and tiny owned process trees. Existing native GUI and graphics save/reload oracles remain required; these controls neither build actual player packages nor qualify Factorio behavior.
